user.title: Samsung EMDX
user.description: The address of the Samsung EMDX web app, as you open it in a browser.

reconfigure.title: Samsung EMDX
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the Samsung EMDX web app.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the app at that address.
error.not_emdx: Something answered at that address, but not the Samsung EMDX app.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address.

abort.already_configured: This app is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the app's state, in seconds. Changes the app reports live show up sooner.

send_image.name: Send image
send_image.description: Sends an image to e-paper displays. A display that's asleep gets it as soon as it can be reached.

url.name: URL
url.description: A link to the image, which the app downloads.

path.name: File
path.description: An image file Home Assistant can read, such as /config/www/snapshot.jpg.

gallery.name: Library item
gallery.description: An image from the app's library, as category/file.jpg.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How the image is sized to the panel. Default: the app's setting.

background.name: Background
background.description: Bar color for fit, like #ffffff. Default: the app's setting.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Tone adjustment. Default: the app's setting.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait for the first attempt to send it (default). Off answers at once.

span_image.name: Span image
span_image.description: Spans one image across a group of displays, each getting its slice. Without an image, the group's last image is sent again.

group.name: Group
group.description: The group's name or id, as in the app.

url.name: URL
url.description: A link to the image, which the app downloads.

path.name: File
path.description: An image file Home Assistant can read, such as /config/www/panorama.jpg.

gallery.name: Library item
gallery.description: An image from the app's library, as category/file.jpg.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How the image is placed on the wall. Default: fill.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Tone adjustment. Default: the app's setting.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait for the first attempt on each display (default). Off answers at once.

update_failed.message: Couldn't read the Samsung EMDX app's state: {error}

cannot_connect.message: Couldn't reach the Samsung EMDX app: {error}

not_loaded.message: No Samsung EMDX app is set up and running.

no_displays.message: Choose at least one Samsung EMDX display.

display_unavailable.message: {target} isn't in any Samsung EMDX app that's running now.

no_image.message: Give an image: one of url, path or gallery.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant isn't allowed to read {path}. Use a file in /config/www or /media, or add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.

unknown_group.message: There's no group "{group}" in the Samsung EMDX app. Groups: {groups}.

span_failed.message: Couldn't send the image to every display in {group}. {errors}
